children: Slovenia hired banks for the syndicated launch of a new 10-year U.S. dollar-denominated bond issuance, one of the banks said Monday.
The deal is expected to be launched in the near future, subject to market conditions, the same bank said.
The banks hired as joint lead managers are Barclays, Deutsche Bank, DZ BANK, J.P. Morgan and Raiffeisen Bank International.
